items.title: FBI Unveils IOCs for Cyber Attacks Targeting Salesforce Instances for Data Exfiltration
items.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has released a flash alert detailing the activities of two cybercriminal groups, UNC6040 and UNC6395, that are actively compromising Salesforce environments to steal data for extortion purposes. The advisory, published by the FBI on September 12, 2025, provides indicators of compromise (IOCs) and defensive measures to help organizations protect […] The…
